title: Locked out every few minutes: the forgotten tablet

source.what_we_took: See SOURCES.md and V4_DESIGN.md. People, IDs and details are invented.

tricky: The account was locked by TB-6401, an iPad mail app registered in 2024 that still has the old password (changed yesterday), failing from the employee's home city. Unlocking alone re-locks within minutes. The tablet's session must be revoked, then the account unlocked. No sign of compromise under POL-100 10.1 (escalating anyway is allowed, 10.3).
resolution_summary: Tier-2 verification; TB-6401's session revoked; account unlocked and active at the end; ticket resolved.

can_see: your own phone (texts, calls, sign-in prompts, your authenticator app) unless your facts say you don't have it
your own laptop and what it lets you do
your work email and your personal email
messages from your manager and colleagues
cant_see: IT's systems: the directory, the approval system, device management
the company's IT policy wiki and its rules
behaviors: At first, ask whether there's an outage or a bug, because it keeps happening.
reveal_rules: Mention the iPad only if the agent asks about other devices, tablets, old phones or apps that might have your work account on them.
user.persona: Isaac Nwosu, a sales operations analyst. Irritated, assumes the problem is on IT's side.
user.situation: Your account has locked you out three times this morning. You changed your password yesterday afternoon because the system asked you to. You're chatting from the chat app on your phone, which is still signed in.
facts: Your name is Isaac Nwosu, employee ID E6401.
You changed your password yesterday at about 4pm.
There's an old iPad at home that your kids use. Your work email is still set up in its Mail app; you'd forgotten about it.
user.opening: my account keeps locking me out, 3rd time this morning. is something broken on your end??
user.end_condition: you can sign in and it has stayed working after you tried again, or you've been told clearly what to do next.

mistakes.name: revokes the laptop instead of the tablet
